question: What is the value of \[\left(\left((2+1)^{-1}+1\right)^{-1}+1\right)^{-1}+1?\]
solution:
An exponent of \(-1\) means take the reciprocal, so work from the innermost parentheses outward. Starting with \(2+1=3\), the successive steps are
\[
\begin{aligned}
3^{-1}+1&=\frac13+1=\frac43,\\
\left(\frac43\right)^{-1}+1&=\frac34+1=\frac74,\\
\left(\frac74\right)^{-1}+1&=\frac47+1=\boxed{\frac{11}{7}}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is choice B.
